newsitem.title: USA: LodgeNet in pact with Red Roof.
newsitem.headline: LodgeNet in pact with Red Roof.

text.p: LodgeNet Entertainment Corp, which provides video on-demand, video games and cable television programming to hotels, said Thursday it had reached an exclusive agreement to provide more services to Red Roof Inns Inc facilities.

LodgeNet already provides free-to-guest basic and premium cable television services to Red Roof. As part of the new agreement, LodgeNet will also provide its Guest Pay interactive services, including movies-on-demand and network-based Super Nintendo video games.
The value of the agreement was not disclosed.
Red Roof is an economy lodging chain that owns and operates 239 properties with more than 27,000 rooms in 33 states.
LodgeNet shares were trading up 1/4 to 15-1/4.
